figurative_meaning_en: others or the rest in plural sense
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইগুলোর মধ্যে কয়েকটা পড়লাম, আর আর পরে পড়ব।
example_sentences_in_english: All the others have come to the party.
I read a few of the books, the rest later.
note: This is a common reduplicative form in Bengali to denote plurality or remainder.
